node.title: Re: Strip html from string using perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Mj1234],

From the FAQs: [doc://perlfaq9#How-do-I-remove-HTML-from-a-string?]

Use [mod://HTML::Strip], or [mod://HTML::FormatText] which not only removes HTML but also attempts to do a little simple formatting of the resulting plain text.

If you really want to use [mod://HTML::Parser], it should be possible by writing a handler for only the text event.

Update: I just noticed that your question is a near-duplicate of your post [id://1166867] from a month ago. Which of the answers there did you try, what worked and what didn't, and why? [id://174051]

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
